editorial:
Imagine being a professional bank robber who finally decides to go straight because he fell in love. That is exactly where you start with this ride. You get to follow a guy who just wants to do the right thing and turn himself in, but he quickly finds out that the FBI agents chasing him are way dirtier than he ever was. It feels like a classic cat-and-mouse game where the good guy is actually a criminal and the bad guys are the ones wearing badges. The vibe is a mix of a tense crime thriller and a romantic drama, making it feel a bit more personal than your average action flick.

Liam Neeson does what he does best here, playing a man who is tired of running but still knows how to fight. The plot moves quickly and keeps you guessing about who to trust. While some of the twists are a bit predictable, the chemistry between the leads makes it work. If you are looking for something fun for a movie night, you should definitely check this out. It looks great streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you love physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a solid move for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the corrupt FBI agents try to steal the stolen money for themselves. You see a big showdown where the main character uses his smarts and combat skills to take them down. He manages to outsmart the bad cops and secure the money. In the end, he gets to be with the woman he loves, and the corrupt agents finally get what they deserve, leaving him to start a truly honest life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Liam Neeson and heist movies with a twist.
